4b6a0dc4a4.q: How did Matt Lawler transition from philosophy and economics into data and insights strategy?
4b6a0dc4a4.a: Lawler started as a philosophy and economics major planning to attend law school and MBA, but in 2003 during a small recession, he took a part-time data entry role at Warner Brothers managing rights and clearances for the International TV Group. Finding the work engaging but only requiring 3-4 hours daily, he spent time with the marketing team on the second floor, eventually taking an analytics role tied to marketing. He went back to business school, then returned to Warner Brothers in audience development, leveraging social media to drive TV consumption, which launched his career in understanding consumer behavior across multiple platforms.
